title: Bewegungsmuster
slide_intent: Give motion a consistent grammar because predictable direction and rhythm help viewers follow change.
strategic_value: A shared set of patterns and easing curves can connect DB campaigns and small interface details.
demonstration: Three illustrated patterns precede primary and secondary curve specifications and one-color versus two-color area behaviors. Video embeds show consent placeholders in this source capture; each film is separately available offline.
practical_value: Choose the primary curve for leading motion and the secondary curve for subsequent motion; choose a simple or dynamic area transition for the communication context.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source connects clear axes and simple movement with room for content and reduced distraction.
reference_purposes.Application: The primary curve is (0.25,0,0.35,1); the supporting ease-out is (0,0,0.2,1). The source distinguishes leading from subsequent motion.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page says animation never becomes complicated or distracts from the content.
